host web-07  kernel 6.8.0-87-generic  x86_64
Intel family 6 model 143  booted 2026-11-16 05:01 UTC

 what a reset right after a fatal memory error would leave on this host

 lost     journal          the directory /var/log/journal
                           does not exist and Storage= is
                           not set: the journal is kept in
                           memory and is gone after a reset
 lost     pstore-backend   no backend is registered: the
                           firmware has no ERST table;
                           efi_pstore has pstore_disable=Y
 lost     pstore-archive   systemd-pstore.service is not
                           enabled: the files stay in
                           /sys/fs/pstore, and a full store
                           saves no later panic
 kept     pstore-vs-kdump  no crash kernel is loaded: a
                           panic goes to pstore
 lost     kdump            no crash kernel is loaded and no
                           crashkernel= is on the command
                           line
 kept     mce-bootlog      on by default for this processor
                           (Intel family 6)
 lost     mce-print        a record left in a bank goes to
                           /dev/mcelog and is not printed,
                           and no mcelog daemon runs
 info     reset-kind       reboot mode cold, the same after
                           a panic. With panic=0 the kernel
                           waits after a panic, and after a
                           fatal machine check it restarts
                           in 30 s. Whether the banks keep
                           their contents over the reset
                           depends on the board and its
                           BIOS; the first stop after my
                           harvest is installed shows it
 none     bert             the firmware provides no BERT
                           table
 none     erst-mce         the firmware provides no ERST
                           table: mce_panic() keeps no copy
                           of the record
 lost     console          no console leaves the host (no
                           console= on the command line):
                           the last lines before a reset
                           stay on its screen
 lost     rasdaemon        rasdaemon is not installed: the
                           corrected errors of a boot are
                           kept only in its kernel log
 lost     harvest          my-harvest.service is not
                           installed: what the boot before
                           left is read only when someone
                           runs my

 8 of 13 checks would lose records. The commands, with what
 each costs and how to undo it:
